# MP3 encoding

Gridex uses the separate, unmodified lamejs JavaScript MP3 encoder (`lame.min.js`). Upstream project and corresponding source: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs. LAME project: https://lame.sourceforge.io/.

The upstream project distributes the encoder under the LGPL; its license notice is preserved in LAME-LICENSE-NOTICE.txt. No ownership of this third-party code is claimed. The encoder is loaded from its separate vendor file at runtime.
